Pellet grills use a slow burn of hard woods, which allows you to "smoke" just about any kind of food you like. Charcoal grills can be extremely messy as they produce charcoal smoke and create quite a mess.
Wood pellets provide a steady, controlled and predictable heat that results in great-tasting meals every time. Charcoal creates a higher and more intense heat, but is not as precise or stable.
Gas grills generally cook food faster, which is most appropriate for thinner foods. Charcoal burns hotter and faster so foods with a more intense flavor, such as charred barbecue, are better suited to charcoal grills.
